ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a slope field approximately within the range [-5,5] by [-5,5]. The small line segments are arranged in a grid; within the same vertical column, the inclination direction and steepness of the small line segments are basically the same. The small line segments near the central vertical axis x=0 are approximately horizontal, indicating that the derivative is 0. The small line segments on the left side of the center incline upward to the right, indicating a positive slope; the small line segments on the right side of the center incline downward to the right, indicating a negative slope. The farther from the central vertical axis, the steeper the small line segments are, showing that the magnitude of the derivative increases as |x| increases. Reasoning: Because the slopes in each vertical column are basically the same, the derivative depends on x and not on y. It can be read from the image that when x=0, the derivative is 0; when x≈1, the derivative is about -2; when x≈-1, the derivative is about +2. These values match a linear function with respect to x, namely derivative = -2x. Therefore, written in the form required by the problem, it is dx/dy = -2x.

method.method_draft: Direct local-slope sampling: First read the slope field image as a grid on roughly [-5,5] by [-5,5]. Notice that within any vertical column the little line segments have essentially the same tilt, so the derivative depends on x but not on y. The segments on the central vertical axis x=0 are flat/zero, the segments on the left side tilt with positive slope, and the segments on the right side tilt with negative slope. Estimate the derivative values from representative columns: near x=1 the displayed slope corresponds to about -2, and near x=-1 it corresponds to about +2, with larger magnitudes farther from the axis. Since the question asks for the equation in the form dx/dy, fit these values to a linear function of x, giving dx/dy=-2x.

推理：因为每个竖直列中的斜率基本相同，所以导数依赖于 x，而不依赖于 y。由图像可读出 x=0 时导数为 0；x≈1 时导数约为 -2；x≈-1 时导数约为 +2。这些值符合一个关于 x 的线性函数，即导数 = -2x。因此写成题目要求的形式为 dx/dy = -2x。

method.method_draft: Qualitative feature-matching / phase-line route: From the image, observe that the slope field is invariant as y changes: each horizontal level shows the same pattern for the same x-value. Therefore the equation should be autonomous in y and depend only on x. The center line x=0 is an equilibrium/nullcline because all segments there are horizontal. On the right half-plane the field points in the negative direction, while on the left half-plane it points in the positive direction, so the derivative has the opposite sign from x. The increasing steepness as one moves away from x=0 indicates the derivative magnitude is proportional to |x|. Thus the form must be dx/dy=-kx for some positive constant k. Use the grid spacing/tilt scale in the field to identify k=2, yielding dx/dy=-2x.
